hints.title: Three regions
hints.body: Maintain a region of zeros at the front, ones in the middle, and unexamined values after that.

hints.title: Three pointers
hints.body: Use `low`, `middle`, and `high` to mark the boundaries.

hints.title: Swap by color
hints.body: A zero swaps to the front, a one stays in the middle, and a two swaps to the back.
